basic_details.job_title: KSCSTE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Project Scientist, Project Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Kerala State Council for Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE), Thiruvananthapuram, is filling two temporary contract posts at the Intellectual Property Rights Information Centre - Keralam (IPRIC-K): one Project Scientist at Rs.66,080/- per month and one Project Associate at Rs.36,580/- per month, both consolidated. The tenure is initially 1 year. Eligible candidates apply through the Google Form link in the notice on or before 30 November 2026 (5.00 pm).

age_limit.details: The age limit for both posts is 36 years as on notification date. The usual age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates will be allowed as per norms. The notice does not mention a minimum age or any experience requirement. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: About KSCSTE
content_sections.text: The Kerala State Council for Science, Technology and Environment has its office at Sasthra Bhavan, Pattom P.O., Thiruvananthapuram - 695 004, Kerala State, India. The notice is signed by P. Harinarayanan, Member Secretary, KSCSTE, and carries the date 13 November 2026. Both posts sit in IPRIC-K and are temporary positions on contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces two vacancies in total.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Project Scientist: Post Graduate Diploma in Intellectual Property Rights; Registered Patent Agent. Project Associate: Post Graduate Diploma in Intellectual Property Rights. The age limit for both posts is 36 years as on notification date. The usual age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates will be allowed as per norms. The notice does not mention a minimum age or any experience requirement. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Doctoral Degree in Science or Masters Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent
Masters Degree in Natural/Agricultural Sciences/MVSc or Bachelors Degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Scientist is paid Rs.66,080/- per month and the Project Associate Rs.36,580/- per month; both amounts are consolidated. The appointment is initially for 1 year and is extendable based on performance.

content_sections.heading: KSCSTE Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct detailed patentability assessment by conducting prior art search and analysis with respect to the inventions and advise the inventors on the patentability scope of their inventions. Conduct Trademark search and advise the Applicants on the scope of registration for the mark/logo. Organize Seminars/Workshops/Training Programmes on IPR across the State in association with various Institutions/Organizations. Handle Technical Sessions on IPR in the Awareness Campaigns. Co-ordinate the Exhibitions/Patent Clinics conducted by IPRIC-K. Take up patent mapping activity with respect to the technology areas having importance to state. Identify potential products from the State for Geographical Indication tag and facilitate the GI registration. Co-ordinate functioning of IPR Cells established by KSCSTE. Provide advice to inventors in protecting their inventions/creations. The job requires travel within the State for co-ordinating/participating in various events. Conduct prior art search on inventions and assess the patentability scope of inventions. Maintain records of all IP filings of IPRIC-K including prior art search and trademark search documents. Generate, collect and collate all technical materials required for IP filing including prior art and trademark search reports conducted. Support the Project Scientist for maintaining Workshop and Training Schedule, collecting and generating technical data for training courses, preparing training modules, etc. The job requires travel within the State for co-ordinating/participating in various events.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KSCSTE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the eligibility for the post, as listed above. Open the application form through the Google Form link given in the notice. Submit the application along with your credentials through that link. Submit on or before 30 November 2026, 5.00 pm. The notice does not list the individual documents. It asks only for the "credentials" to be submitted with the application.
